biggest_catch: A 15-15.5 hour Election Day (5am to ~8-8:30pm) for $250; the $25 training payment is separate with unstated duration.
catches: Officers must arrive at 5am and cannot leave the polling place during work hours.
Polls close 7pm and closing tasks take about 1-1.5 hours, so the day ends around 8-8:30pm.
Training attendance pays $25; training duration is not published, so training time is excluded from the numeric figures.
Appointment requires a signed Oath witnessed by a Notary, Clerk of Court, Electoral Board member, or Registrar staff.

eligibility: Complete the Officer of Election Oath/Affirmation and Response to Appointment, witnessed by an authorized official; serve the full Election Day.
notes: Framed on Election Day: $250 for 5am to ~8-8:30pm (900-930 min; closing usually about 1-1.5 hrs after the 7pm poll close). The $25 training attendance payment is excluded from both payout and time because the training duration is unstated.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($250 Election Day); time: arrive 5am, polls close 7pm, closing usually about 1-1.5 hrs = 900-930 min; $25 training payment excluded from both (duration unstated)
payout_quote: Officers of Election must arrive at the precinct by 5 a.m. and must stay until all closing tasks have been completed. The polls close at 7 p.m., and closing tasks usually take about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Montgomery County pays $250.00 for Election Day plus $25.00 to attend training. Officer assignments last the full day (with breaks).
payout_value_note: $250 for Election Day. A separate $25 is paid to attend training (duration unstated, excluded from both).

steps: Complete the Officer of Election Oath or Affirmation and Response to Appointment, witnessed by a Notary, Clerk of Court, Electoral Board member, or Registrar staff.
Return forms in person, by mail, email (govote121@montgomerycountyva.gov), or fax (540-381-6811).
Serve Election Day: arrive by 5am, stay until closing tasks complete (~8-8:30pm).
timing: Election Day (5am to ~8-8:30pm); training in advance.
